concept.architecture: A monolithic moon rocker turns around a 6 mm printed axle at Z=17.5. The base carries two keyway cheeks and prismatic U-guards around the moon edges. The axle inserts with its tapered tab horizontal and locks after a 90-degree turn.
concept.interaction: Press the top of either moon; the rigid beam rocks and raises the opposite moon. Release or press the raised side to reverse the motion. The machine is manually alternating and stores no intentional elastic energy.
concept.limitations: Digital geometry establishes dimensions, source-derived clearances, collision-free rigid motion, locked axial capture, mesh integrity, bed fit, and minimum wall sampling. It does not establish a successful print, physical fit, required force, retention force, stability, wear, durability, cycle life, or human response.
concept.summary: A support-free three-part desk machine in a 92 × 54 × 25 mm neutral envelope. Two cratered 22 mm moons are the ends of one exposed equal-arm rocker; pressing either moon through an 8-degree half-cycle raises the other by an 8.35 mm height difference. A printed quarter-turn keyway axle captures the assembly without purchased hardware.
concept.title: Lunar Relay

research.capture_basis: The locked 13.0 mm tab exceeds the diamond opening's 9.617 mm diagonal, leaving 1.692 mm geometric engagement per side. A 12-step digital pull sweep finds the far tab blocked by the base, while the 90-degree lock rotation remains clear.
research.clearance_basis: The 6.0 mm axle derives a 6.8 mm across-flats diamond bore using cadfits free fit. The 13.0 × 3.2 mm locking tab derives a 13.8 × 4.0 mm unlocked keyway. The rocker-to-cheek gap derives once at 0.50 mm per side.
research.evidence_boundary: No purchased component or powered load exists. Deterministic evidence is stored under cad/moon_relay/measure, including the final verification pipeline, fit/spec audits, motion manifest, thickness reports, and exact assembled-STL render review.
research.kinematic_derivation: At 30 mm moon-center radius and ±8 degrees, the two moon centers exchange a total vertical difference of 2 × 30 × sin(8 degrees) = 8.350 mm. Full-solid outer-edge clearance above the 4 mm floor is 0.862 mm at the declared extreme.
research.manufacturing_basis: Nominal process is 0.4 mm-nozzle FDM. Base and rocker print on broad flat faces; axle prints upright on its 13 mm head and expands to the tab on self-supporting shoulders. All three exact STLs pass bed, watertightness, manifold, winding, one-shell, positive-volume, and 0.8 mm wall gates.
